steps.name: prompted-task-events-only
steps.detail: Pre-case clear: `atm teams clear-nudge-template --team fx-at11 --kind task_reminder --json` -> {"action":"clear-nudge-template","team":"fx-at11","kind":"task_reminder","cleared":false}. Assigned 3 tasks to fx-at11-beta as fx-at11-alpha: at11-case1-t1-1790206925, at11-case1-t2-1790206925, at11-case1-t3-1790206925 (`atm task assign fx-at11-beta "..." --task-id <id> --json`). Polled `atm task events at11-case1-t1-1790206925 --json` every 5s. First excerpt (t=+38s) already showed handoffs [{"kind":"task_queued","at":"2026-09-23T23:42:05.053Z","trigger":"steer"},{"kind":"task_ready","at":"2026-09-23T23:42:08.583727224Z","trigger":"task_pass"}] and events [{"event":"assigned","at":"...05.053759776Z"},{"event":"reminded","at":"...08.583727224Z","outcome":"emitted"}]. Continued polling every 5s (within the 150s cap measured from assignment) and captured the first true task_reminder handoff at t=+63.5s: {"agent":"fx-at11-beta","attempt":1,"kind":"task_reminder","at":"2026-09-23T23:43:08.584920124Z","trigger":"task_pass"}. Observed interval = task_reminder(2026-09-23T23:43:08.584920124Z) - task_ready(2026-09-23T23:42:08.583727224Z) = 60.001193s, confirmed by a third data point task_reminder attempt 2 at 2026-09-23T23:44:13.578039638Z (delta 64.99s) and attempt 3 at 2026-09-23T23:45:13.578347805Z (delta 60.00s from attempt 2) -- consistent with the documented ~60s default. Ran `atm task start at11-case1-t1-1790206925 "starting case1 task1" --json` as fx-at11-beta -> {"action":"send","outcome":"sent","task_id":"at11-case1-t1-1790206925",...}. Final `atm task events at11-case1-t1-1790206925 --json` handoffs in order: task_queued(23:42:05.053Z) -> task_ready(23:42:08.583727224Z) -> task_reminder attempt1(23:43:08.584920124Z) -> task_reminder attempt2(23:44:13.578039638Z) -> task_reminder attempt3(23:45:13.578347805Z) -> task_started(23:46:09.745Z); events in order assigned -> reminded x4 -> started(to_state:active). PASS: task 1 shows queued, ready, reminder, started in order. Concurrently, `atm task events at11-case1-t2-1790206925 --json` and `atm task events at11-case1-t3-1790206925 --json`, re-checked at t+190s, each showed only events:[{"event":"assigned"}] and handoffs:[{"kind":"task_queued"}] -- queued only, as required.

steps.name: disabled-reminder-doctor-finding
steps.detail: `atm teams disable-nudge-template --team fx-at11 --kind task_reminder --json` -> {"action":"disable-nudge-template","team":"fx-at11","kind":"task_reminder","updated_at":"2026-09-23T23:46:37.594015295Z"}. Assigned new task at11-case2-t1-1790207197 to fx-at11-beta (`atm task assign ... --json` -> {"task_id":"at11-case2-t1-1790207197"}) at 2026-09-23T23:46:37.604097287Z. Waited in the foreground via a Bash sleep-loop (two calls, 90s then 40s = 130s wall time; task actually re-checked at 2026-09-23T23:49:05.910300594Z, i.e. ~148s after assignment), longer than the case-1 observed interval x2 (60.001193s x 2 = 120.002386s). `atm task events at11-case2-t1-1790207197 --json` after the wait showed events:[{"event":"assigned","at":"...37.604097287Z"},{"event":"reminded","at":"...38.589644583Z","outcome":"emitted"}] and handoffs:[{"kind":"task_queued","at":"...37.604Z"},{"kind":"task_ready","at":"...38.589644583Z"}] -- queued and ready present, no task_reminder kind in handoffs and no further reminded event despite the long wait. `atm doctor --json --team fx-at11` reported: {"severity":"warning","code":"ATM_WARNING_OBSERVABILITY_HEALTH_DEGRADED","message":"disabled_task_nudge_template_override: team fx-at11 has disabled `task_reminder`","remediation":"atm teams clear-nudge-template --team fx-at11 --kind task_reminder"}. PASS: queued+ready with no reminder, and doctor surfaces disabled_task_nudge_template_override.

steps.name: cleanup
steps.detail: Closed all created tasks with public task commands: `atm task close at11-case1-t1-1790206925 completed "case1 t1 done" --json` -> {"action":"send","outcome":"sent","task_id":"at11-case1-t1-1790206925",...}; `atm task close at11-case1-t2-1790206925 cancelled "case1 t2 cleanup" --json` -> {"outcome":"sent","task_id":"at11-case1-t2-1790206925",...}; `atm task close at11-case1-t3-1790206925 cancelled "case1 t3 cleanup" --json` -> {"outcome":"sent","task_id":"at11-case1-t3-1790206925",...}; `atm task close at11-case2-t1-1790207197 cancelled "case2 cleanup" --json` -> {"outcome":"sent","task_id":"at11-case2-t1-1790207197",...}. Verified `atm task list --as fx-at11-beta --team fx-at11 --json` -> [] (empty queue) after each close round. Ran `atm teams clear-nudge-template --team fx-at11 --kind task_reminder --json` -> {"action":"clear-nudge-template","team":"fx-at11","kind":"task_reminder","cleared":true}. Final `atm doctor --json --team fx-at11` findings no longer include disabled_task_nudge_template_override (only ATM_ROSTER_NO_LEAD warning and OBSERVABILITY_HEALTH_OK infos remain).
